# Animation regression fixture

`gsap.min.js` is the unmodified GSAP 3.15.0 distribution from commit
`13e2b790546426a1a2e0e9b409f3f8dc6d6611f2` of https://github.com/greensock/GSAP.

Copyright GreenSock, Inc. The upstream copyright/license notice remains in the
file. GSAP uses its Standard "no charge" license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/.
This is a test fixture, not an open-source MIT dependency and not part of the
distributed extension. The runtime adapter calls the page's own installed GSAP;
it does not ship a copy of GSAP.
